title: completion reported for a piece
description: An implementer's report that a piece is done at a commit. The report itself is not stored: only its hash, its size and which declared checks it names.

reported_by.description: The implementer, when the claim was recorded by someone else on its behalf (check verify under a token, which can write only in the verifier's own name).

paths.description: Directory prefixes the commit changed since the merge-base (at most 20); the brief scopes by them.
